messages.subject: Executive Value Creation Brief | Weatherford | Sustainability & Stakeholder Strategy
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Ruzicka,

I am sharing a strategic value creation brief prepared for Weatherford, focused on sustainability, workforce strategy, organizational resilience, integration and stakeholder confidence in energy services. My current work spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and cross-functional execution in a multinational mining environment.

The attached brief outlines areas where this experience could support strategic integration and accountable sustainability delivery. I would welcome a short discussion regarding senior leadership or strategic mandates where my background would add value.

Regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop

strategic_brief.title: Strategic Value Creation Brief for Weatherford
strategic_brief.executive_summary: Ragunauth Ramsaroop offers a leadership profile aligned with Weatherford's agenda across sustainability, workforce strategy, organizational resilience, integration and stakeholder confidence in energy services. His experience combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships, social performance and executive advisory in a multinational mining environment. He works across operations, legal, finance, procurement, HR, security, aviation and technical teams, translating external obligations into coordinated execution. For Weatherford, his strongest contribution would sit where sustainability commitments, people priorities, regulatory expectations and operational change require common governance, evidence and executive accountability across business units and markets.
strategic_brief.company_context: Weatherford's 2026 disclosures show continued operational focus alongside portfolio expansion, acquisition activity and corporate restructuring. The acquisition of NCS Multistage broadens the completions portfolio, while the company's financial and governance agenda continues to evolve. In this setting, workforce integration, sustainability, operational continuity and stakeholder confidence are interconnected. Executives need clear visibility of commitments, risks, owners and evidence across corporate and operating functions. A leadership approach that links ESG, people strategy, government relations and disciplined execution can support smoother integration, strengthen reputation and ensure external commitments remain anchored in measurable operational outcomes.

opportunities.title: Integration and stakeholder governance
opportunities.rationale: Acquisitions and organizational change create overlapping workforce, regulatory, community and customer expectations. A structured governance model helps integrate commitments while preserving operating continuity and management accountability.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I can establish integration issue registers, stakeholder maps, ownership matrices and executive reporting routines linking people, sustainability, legal, operations and external affairs.

opportunities.title: Sustainability operating discipline
opportunities.rationale: Energy-services sustainability performance depends on clear data ownership, operational controls and consistent definitions across facilities, projects and business units rather than reporting activity alone.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I can build assurance-ready evidence registers and review routines that connect ESG commitments to operational owners, source data, corrective actions and management decisions.

opportunities.title: Workforce and institutional confidence
opportunities.rationale: Workforce resilience and external trust reinforce each other where safety, skills, local participation and community expectations affect license to operate and customer confidence.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I can coordinate institutional engagement with HR, operations and social-performance priorities, producing measurable commitments and consistent executive narratives across key markets.

days_0_30: Map integration priorities, sustainability commitments and key stakeholder interfaces.
days_31_60: Create ownership matrices, evidence registers and executive issue dashboards.
days_61_90: Launch cross-functional governance for integration, workforce and ESG workstreams.
days_91_180: Embed metrics, assurance checks and executive reporting across priority operations.

potential_impact: Stronger operational ownership of sustainability commitments.
Improved workforce and stakeholder confidence across key markets.
background_relevance: Government and regulatory relations in a complex resource-sector environment.
ESG, corporate affairs, social-performance and strategic-partnership leadership.
Cross-functional coordination with HR, operations, legal, finance, procurement and security teams.
